Please read /papers/investigations-5/01_heat_density_asymptotics/ansatz/research-progress/handoffs/HDA-A01-AN01.md, and the research overview 01_HIGH_HEIGHT_ANSATZ_RESEARCH_OVERVIEW_20261025. 

Please continue the research. Track your progress in the research progress folder, write research notes in the notes folder, and record chat history in the chat-histories folder within the ansatz folder.
I’ll read the handoff, overview, and repository instructions, then continue the investigation and save the research notes, progress record, and chat history in the ansatz folder.

The handoff sets a bounded, analytical task: calibrate the outer formula and attempt one bridge through zero time. I’m checking the gamma correction and negative-time smoothing in parallel, with particular attention to the growing arithmetic sum and cutoff terms.

The first gamma-carrier calculation confirms the stated normalization and shows that heat curvature and the Gaussian determinant contribute at the same order as the first correction. On the negative-time side, the bare Riemann–Siegel error loses too much at the proposed carrier scale; retaining its first correction appears to recover a vanishing real-axis error. I’m checking the tails and cutoff crossings, then isolating what remains unpaid on the complex strip.

The analysis now supports a bounded result for real heights on both sides of zero: the heat-weighted finite sum, with a retained Riemann–Siegel correction, has an error that vanishes uniformly when \(|t|\log(X/(4\pi))\le8\). The compact positive-time formula also has its first correction and spatial/time error bounds.

The remaining gap is a uniform complex-strip remainder needed for buffered derivatives. I’ll record that gap and a focused next task without promoting the real-axis result to the full strip.

The internal check caught a buffer-dependent issue: the fixed contour split needs a polynomial bound whose exponent depends on the strip width. I’ve corrected it; the resulting outer error bounds are unchanged.

I’m finishing the assessment and updating the manuscript and progress register. The next task will target the complex remainder; the real-axis bridge has been established at the stated precision.
I’m using the PDF skill to rebuild the maintained manuscript and check the layout of the new formulas.

The note, assessment, progress update, next handoff, and chat history are saved. The updated 15-page manuscript compiled without warnings, and the rendered pages passed the layout check. AN01 is closed at its permitted partial scope; AN02 asks Sol to prove the complex remainder needed for the buffered crossover result.

Continued the research and saved [Note03](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/01_heat_density_asymptotics/ansatz/notes/03_OUTER_CORRECTION_AND_SIGNED_REAL_BRIDGE_20261025.md), establishing:

- The first corrected outer expansion on \(32\le t\le33\), with spatial and time error bounds.
- A corrected real-axis bridge through zero for \(|t|\log(X/(4\pi))\le8\).

These have same-model internal assessment only. The full complex-strip extension remains open; [AN02](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/01_heat_density_asymptotics/ansatz/research-progress/handoffs/HDA-A01-AN02.md) defines the next task for **Analysis — Sol**.

Progress and chat history were updated. The manuscript rebuilt cleanly and passed layout checks.

:codex-file-citation{path="/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/output/pdf/heat_density_ansatz/heat_density_ansatz.pdf" purpose="output"}
Please continue with HDA-A01-AN02 and the complex-strip remainder. Track progress, save research notes, and record chat history in the corresponding folders within ansatz.
I’ll read AN02 and the current progress entry, then work on the fixed-cutoff complex remainder and save the proof or precise remaining gap in the ansatz folders.

Two routes are making progress. The published Riemann–Siegel contour expansion appears to give the complex remainder directly. Separately, a local maximum-principle argument gives a small power loss that would still suffice for AN02. I’m checking the contour coefficients and branches before using the stronger estimate.

The complex remainder now closes without a power loss. The rectangle argument preserves the required decay by grouping the Dirichlet tail on its upper edge, and a separate check against the published contour expansion agrees.

Using that estimate, the small-time bridge also extends to the full fixed buffers, including three spatial derivatives. The exact heat identity and the model’s residual give a first time-derivative bound through zero without a \(1/|t|\) loss. I’m writing up the window and tail estimates and checking the scope before updating the manuscript.

The proof and internal assessment are complete. The write-up now fixes the tail constants before choosing the averaging window, covers shifted chart centers in the source bound, and uses moduli for complex weights.

AN02 closes at its bounded scope, with error allowance
\(\delta=X^{-3/4}e^{t_-L_X^2/16}\), which is at most \(C X^{-1/4}\) throughout \(|t|L_X\le8\). I’m saving the records and rebuilding the manuscript. The next regime will be a fixed negative-time interval, where this shrinking-time estimate no longer suffices.

AN02 is saved with the complex-strip remainder and buffered field, spatial-derivative, and time-derivative bounds. The progress register and chat history are updated. The 16-page manuscript compiled without warnings and passed layout inspection.

The result remains proved in-note with same-model internal assessment. I also prepared the next bounded Sol packet for \(1\le T\le2\); it has not been dispatched.

Completed AN02. [Note04](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/01_heat_density_asymptotics/ansatz/notes/04_COMPLEX_STRIP_REMAINDER_AND_BUFFERED_CROSSOVER_20261025.md) proves:

- The complex-strip remainder without an \(\epsilon\) loss.
- Full buffered field estimates, three spatial derivatives, and a first time derivative through zero for \(|t|L_X\le8\).

Progress, assessment, manuscript, and chat history are saved. Status remains **proved in-note, with same-model internal review only**.

Next: **Analysis — Sol**, [HDA-A02-AN01](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/01_heat_density_asymptotics/ansatz/research-progress/handoffs/HDA-A02-AN01.md), covering fixed negative times \(1\le T\le2\).

:codex-file-citation{path="/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/output/pdf/heat_density_ansatz/heat_density_ansatz.pdf" purpose="output"}
Please continue with HDA-A02-AN01 for fixed negative times 1≤T≤2. Track progress, save research notes, and record chat history in the corresponding folders within ansatz.

I’ll read the fixed-negative-time packet and current progress record, then work on the estimates needed for \(1\le T\le2\). I’ll save the proof or precise remaining gap, update progress, and refresh the existing ansatz chat history.

There are now two useful outcomes on \(1\le T\le2\). The short arithmetic formula appears to extend with a vanishing error at the undeformed gamma scale, though that still does not control the smaller outer carrier. A second representation uses a Riemann–Siegel order and a common gamma-curvature polynomial that both grow like \(\log X\); it appears to pay the outer-carrier error.

I’m checking the order-dependent constants and cutoff transfers so the two accuracy claims stay distinct.

The fixed negative-time argument now has two distinct accuracy results: a short formula at the gamma-envelope scale, and a larger finite representation accurate at the smaller outer-carrier scale. I’m recording the proofs and review, updating the manuscript, and preparing the next packet to bridge this result toward \(t=0\).

The checks support both results on \(1\le T\le2\), including three spatial derivatives and the first time derivative. The outer-scale representation pays both growing-order costs: the Riemann–Siegel remainder and the curvature of every arithmetic heat mode. It still retains a correction integral; a short outer-scale formula and a practical evaluation-cost bound remain open.

The research note, assessment, progress ledger, and next handoff are saved in the ansatz folders. The manuscript builds without warnings, and I’ve inspected all 19 rendered pages, including the new formulas. HDA-A02 remains Partial; the next packet asks Sol to extend the representation down to \(T=4/\log(X/(4\pi))\) and join it to the proved crossover near zero.

Completed HDA-A02-AN01 for \(1\le T\le2\). [Note05](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/01_heat_density_asymptotics/ansatz/notes/05_FIXED_NEGATIVE_TIME_REPRESENTATIONS_20261025.md) establishes:

- Short-model error \(O(|G|X^{-3/4})\).
- A larger finite representation with error \(O(E_o e^{-L_X^2/4})\).

Both include buffered spatial derivatives through order three and the first time derivative. Review is same-model only; broader HDA-A02 remains Partial.

Progress, assessment, manuscript, and chat records were updated. The manuscript builds without warnings.

Next: **Analysis — Sol**, [HDA-A02-AN02](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/01_heat_density_asymptotics/ansatz/research-progress/handoffs/HDA-A02-AN02.md).

> Continue AN02: prove the bridge \(4/L_X\le T\le2\) and join to Note04, paying all kernel, derivative, and joining errors.

:codex-file-citation{path="/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/output/pdf/heat_density_ansatz/heat_density_ansatz.pdf" purpose="output"}

Please continue with HDA-A02-AN02: prove the bridge 4/L_X≤T≤2 and join to Note04, paying all kernel, derivative, and joining errors. Track progress, save research notes, and record chat history in the corresponding folders within ansatz. At the end, please summarize all of the progress within this chat.

I’ll read the frozen AN02 packet and current proofs, then work through the small-\(T\) kernel losses and the join to Note04. I’ll save the research and review in the ansatz folders, update progress and chat history, and finish with a summary of everything established in this chat.

The bridge estimates close with the same orders and window used in Note05. At \(T\ge4/L_X\), the complex-kernel loss is at most \(e^{b^2L_X/16}\); derivative losses add only powers of \(L_X\), so the \(e^{-L_X^2/4}\) error bound survives.

The join adds a time-derivative term proportional to \(L_X\chi'(TL_X)\). The two field comparisons pay that term. Its contribution is confined to the overlap, while the crossover model’s own heat residual persists nearer zero.

The same-model checks found no blocking flaw in the bridge or join. The joined formula now has vanishing outer-envelope errors across \([-2,0]\), including spatial derivatives through order three and the first time derivative. Above \(TL_X=8\), it retains the stronger exponential error bound and has exactly zero heat residual.

I’m saving the proof and a chat-wide summary covering the positive-time correction, complex crossover, fixed negative-time representations, and this final bridge.

The proof and whole-chat summary are saved. The manuscript has rebuilt without warnings; I’m checking the rendered pages and file links now.

The next prepared packet moves to the regulator branch: comparing corrected one-arm models and their centers near \(t=64\), using the actual center sensitivity. It preserves the existing layer theorem and does not claim sharper density or covariance estimates.

Completed HDA-A02-AN02. [Note06](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/01_heat_density_asymptotics/ansatz/notes/06_NEGATIVE_BRIDGE_AND_TIME_JOIN_20261025.md) proves the bridge \(4/L_X\le T\le2\), retaining error \(O(E_o e^{-L_X^2/4})\), and pays the join to Note04.

On full fixed buffers throughout \([-2,0]\), the joined errors are:

- Spatial derivatives \(j\le3\): \(O(E_oX^{-1/4}(1+L_X)^j)\).
- First time derivative: \(O(E_oX^{-1/4}(1+L_X)^2)\).
- Actual heat residual: \(O(E_oX^{-1/4}(1+L_X))\), vanishing exactly for \(TL_X\ge8\).

Across this chat, we have:

1. Calibrated the outer amplitude and phase and proved its first correction on \(32\le t\le33\).
2. Closed the complex Riemann–Siegel remainder gap and proved buffered field, spatial, and time estimates through zero.
3. Established distinct short gamma-scale and finite outer-scale representations for \(1\le T\le2\).
4. Completed the shrinking-to-fixed bridge and joined negative interval \([-2,0]\).

The [complete chat summary](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/01_heat_density_asymptotics/ansatz/notes/07_CHAT0001_RESEARCH_SUMMARY_20261025.md), assessment, progress ledger, and chat records are saved. Results have same-model internal review only; numerical onsets, physical transfer, and all-time coverage remain open.

Next: **Analysis — Sol**, [HDA-A03-AN01](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/01_heat_density_asymptotics/ansatz/research-progress/handoffs/HDA-A03-AN01.md).

> Continue HDA-A03-AN01: compare corrected one-arm models and regulator centers near \(t=64\), retaining the exact physical sensitivity.

The updated 20-page manuscript builds without warnings and passed rendered-page inspection.
